name: benji-pays
description: Configure Benji Pays for multi-gateway AR: collections, Invoice Rover, automatic payments, Pay Now, portals, accounting sync, existing merchant accounts, and embedded SaaS/MSP workflows.

BENJI_PAYS_API_KEY.title: Benji Pays API key
